description.value: Pho Century Fine Vietnamese Cuisine is a sit-down Vietnamese restaurant located on Kingsway in Burnaby, a busy commercial corridor that connects several cycling routes across the municipality. The restaurant offers indoor-only seating in a no-smoking environment. Its pho and Vietnamese menu would offer a warm, hearty meal option for cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor.
